lines.li: [colony:Open] Travelers are welcome here, as the road already knows. They'll camp {PLACE} for a while.
[skill:Social] {A_nameDef} sends word down that they're welcome, and asks where they've come from. They'll camp {PLACE} for a while.
[colony:Guarded] They may stay, on the colony's terms. The colony's terms are known on the road to be firm ones.
[colony:Thrifty] Paying people to leave isn't the colony's habit, but it paid. They take the silver and go.
[winter] They pack up in the cold without a word to anyone, and go.
[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} is the one who tells them, as gently as it can be done. They go.
Three of the colony walk out to their camp to say it plainly. They pack in a hurry.
[lowtech] {X_nameDef} tucks the books back into the satchel and goes on to the next settlement.
{X_nameDef} took the answer well, or tried to, and went back the way {X_pronoun} came.
[!lowtech] {X_nameDef} stood at the gate a while longer, said nothing more, and walked back out to the road.
[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} sat with {X_nameDef} until the crying stopped, and then {X_nameDef} was walked back toward {X_possessive} people. {FACTION} will hear who brought their child home.
{X_nameDef} stays, and asks every morning when {X_pronoun} is going home. The grown-ups change the subject.
